parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed maps on its surface. It has a diameter of approximately 15 cm.
parts.Functional_description: It displays the geographical features of the Earth and can rotate around its axis for educational and demonstrative purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around the tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base and supporting frame of the globe, made of plastic, with a height of about 10 cm and a circular base diameter of 12 cm.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support to hold the rotating sphere in place and maintain stability on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed support for the rotating sphere.
